identification: Two boxes of mixed vintage books. Box 1: children's and juvenile fiction (Pixie O'Harris 'The Fairy Who Wouldn't Fly', Robinson Crusoe Collins, Tintin (Methuen), Tales of Pooh, Tale of Peter Rabbit, Jules Verne 'Adrift in the Pacific', Sir Walter Scott Ivanhoe, Montgomery 'Rainbow Valley', C.S. Lewis 'The Lion the Witch and the Wardrobe' (grey Bles-style spine), Mary Grant Bruce, Seahawk, 'Where's Master' Caesar the King's Dog, Mark Twain Adam's Diary). Box 2: botany and gardening paperbacks plus the hardback Flora of New Zealand Vols I-III (Allan; Moore and Edgar; Healy and Edgar), Mosses and Liverworts of New Zealand, Maori Games and Hakas (Armstrong), Anna Pavord Plant Partners, Eucalypt and wattle booklets.
